issue: Recurring /loop macro: Wave 4 research and implementation of portable root resolution and runtime state hardening.
problem: Every Rust ring and ProjectPaths.swift hardcoded /Users/playra/BrowserOS-full/trios as TRIOS_ROOT fallback, blocking multi-machine/CI deployment and leaking developer identity. Runtime state (e2e logs, rollback snapshots, dev sandboxes) lived in /tmp.
fix: Centralized root resolution in trios-config::project_dir() with TRIOS_ROOT override and current_dir() fallback. Added trios-config dependency to all rings that lacked it and replaced local project_dir() helpers. Moved clade-e2e logs/screenshots to .trinity/e2e/ and clade-improve rollback/dev to .trinity/rollback/ and .trinity/dev/. ASCII-cleaned all touched Rust source and Cargo.toml descriptions. Updated .gitignore for runtime artifacts and untracked akashic-log.jsonl.
tests_added: Existing workspace tests; no new tests added in this wave. cargo test --workspace passed 332 tests.
verification: ./build.sh passed; cargo test --workspace passed; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features produced only pre-existing trios-mesh expect_used warnings; grep /Users/playra/ returned zero matches in rings/ and BR-OUTPUT/; ASCII scan of changed files clean.
pattern: Centralize environment-derived paths in a RUST-00 config crate, propagate the dependency to all rings, and mechanically replace local helpers. Move /tmp runtime state into project-relative .trinity/ subdirs.
anti_pattern: Do not leave hardcoded developer home paths as fallbacks; do not use /tmp for persistent runtime state in production code.
